title: Vehicle photo guide
intro: These angles are suggestions and can be skipped. Submit at least 1 and at most 20 photos per report.
damageHint: Take close-ups of each scratch or damaged area and describe its location for comparison.
missingMessage: Angles without photos: {{angles}}. You can add photos or send the current report.

hints.Front: Face the vehicle and include the entire front, lights and bumper.
hints.Rear: Include the entire rear and a clearly readable license plate.
hints.Left: Capture the entire left side and wheels, relative to the direction of travel.
hints.Right: Capture the entire right side and wheels, relative to the direction of travel.
hints.FrontLeft: Shoot at roughly 45° to show the front and left side.
hints.FrontRight: Shoot at roughly 45° to show the front and right side.
hints.RearLeft: Shoot at roughly 45° to show the rear and left side.
hints.RearRight: Shoot at roughly 45° to show the rear and right side.
hints.Dashboard: Turn on the dashboard and show total mileage and fuel or battery level clearly. Add another photo if needed.
hints.Interior: Show the seats, dashboard and cleanliness; add rear-seat photos if needed.
hints.Damage: Take close-ups plus a wider photo to identify the damaged area.
hints.Other: Add details, accessories or other areas you want to document.
